'''Gelnar Tol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|designer]] who was forced to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After being abducted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], he was among a group forced to work on the [[Sarlacc Project]].
